## dsh-pet-plugin 1.8.2

A photo-real desk pet for the DeepSeek Harness web UI. She lives in the bottom-right
corner, drops by on her own schedule, talks, dances, gets shy or annoyed, and carries a
small input box you can chat with — **without ever writing to your session**.

### Highlights

- **Four photo-real personas** — 薇 / 绯 / 靛 / 雪 — same lighting and framing, five
  expressions each (default / happy / shy / angry / sleepy).
- **Action sequences** — dance, hair-flip and walk, three frames each played as a 340 ms
  flip-book, stylised per character (绯 is a catwalk, 雪 is a straight-line walk).
- **Voice** — optional neural TTS (晓晓 / 晓伊 / 晓墨) when the host has a python with
  `edge-tts`; otherwise it falls back to the system `speechSynthesis`. Pitch and rate are
  adjustable in the panel.
- **Private chat** — the small input box answers with a one-shot model call routed through
  the plugin's own endpoint. Nothing is added to your conversation history.
- **i18n** — the panel, persona taglines and the chat system prompt follow the browser
  interface language: `en / zh / es / pt / hi`, shipped as `locale/*.json` with the `pet`
  namespace and registered per the DSH slot `locale` contract.
- **Effects** — ink, confetti, cloud, wipable fog, bomb + cracked screen; confetti when a
  long turn ends, a cloud when a tool call fails.

### Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-pet-plugin
```

From a local checkout, quit DSH and run `install.cmd` instead.

Optional, for the neural voice:

```bash
pip install edge-tts
```

### Notes

- The pet renders inside the DSH window only — it cannot float above other applications.
- Settings live in `localStorage`; the debug handle (`globalThis.__dshPet`) stays off
  unless you set `dsh-pet.debug=1` or append `?petdebug=1`.
- Host routes are origin-whitelisted: only the host's own origin and `dsh-app://` may call
  them.

Full changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/zuoyunlai/dsh-pet-plugin/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
